mcqs.question: What is the correct sum of the complex numbers (3 + 2i) and (-5 + 4i)?
mcqs.explanation: Add the real parts: 3 + (-5) = -2. Add the imaginary parts: 2i + 4i = 6i. Hence the sum is -2 + 6i. Options B, C and D contain common mistakes such as adding the real parts incorrectly or ignoring the imaginary part.

mcqs.question: Find the result of (4 - 3i) - (1 + 5i).
mcqs.explanation: Subtract real parts: 4 - 1 = 3. Subtract imaginary parts: -3i - 5i = -8i. Therefore the difference is 3 - 8i. Option B adds the imaginary parts, C adds instead of subtracting, and D changes both signs.

mcqs.question: Which of the following expressions is equivalent to the product (2 + i)(3 - 2i)?
mcqs.explanation: Multiply: (2)(3)=6, (2)(-2i)=-4i, (i)(3)=3i, (i)(-2i)=-2i^2=+2. Adding gives 6+2=8 and -4i+3i=-i, so 8 - i. Options B, C, D have sign or magnitude errors.

mcqs.question: Evaluate (5 + 12i) ÷ (3 - 4i) and express the answer in a + bi form.
mcqs.explanation: Multiply numerator and denominator by the conjugate of the denominator: (5+12i)(3+4i)= -33 + 56i. Denominator becomes 3^2+4^2=25. Hence the quotient is (-33/25) + (56/25)i. Options B, C, D have incorrect signs.
